components.name: LineChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Line-Chart (6643:63324): an Accent/Solid 2px line over an area fading Accent/Solid → Accent/Subtle, on a
dashed Border/Neutral/Pale grid with 6 Y labels; each X value is a sector, the active one marked by an Active/Accent/Solid
rule (idle sectors draw none, as Figma's Sector Default) and a Tooltip with its value. Like Figma's Chart-Visual it starts at the plot's left edge (level
with the first value) and ends on the last sector's centre. With `compare` it is Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart (set
15501:3054, Sector 4 · 6 · 7 · 12): the same chart plus one dashed Border/Neutral/Solid line at 40%, both values in the
Tooltip and a legend. ←/→, Home/End move between points.

props.name: data
props.description: One point per period (`{ label, value }`). Keep 4–12 periods.

props.name: label
props.description:
What the line measures ("Invoiced"), named in the legend and the summary once there is a `compare`. Default: the
 aria-label.

props.name: compare
props.description:
A comparison over the same periods — last year, the plan, what was collected — drawn as a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid
 line at 40%, dashed 4 / 5, with a legend (Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart): one value per point of `data`, in order.

props.name: format
props.description:
How axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary read: a function (`(v) => v + " GB"`), or a preset a Zen Studio page
 can write as text — `"compact"` 1.2K (the default), `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the plot in px, lanes included (a seventh of it for the Tooltip lane on top and one for the X labels below,
 as Figma's 14-row Trend grid).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue invoiced per month, Apr – Sep 2026").

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description:
The point active at first and whenever the pointer leaves. Default: none — the active point and its Tooltip show
 only under the pointer or the keyboard (the user, 2026-10-26).

props.name: curve
props.description: `smooth` (default, Figma's curve) or `linear` segments.

props.name: fill
props.description:
The area under the line: `area` (default: Figma's fade, Accent/Solid at the top to Accent/Subtle at the baseline, at
 30%) or `none`; `gradient` is deprecated and draws the same area.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend of the line and its comparison (default on with `compare`; colour is never the only key).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the line in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: showAverage
props.description: A dotted line at the mean of the line (not the comparison), tagged "Avg $95.4K" (Figma Show Average).

components.name: BarChart
components.description:
Bar chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): Chart/Sector/Primary bars with
Corner-Radius/Small, the active one Chart/Sector/Secondary with its Tooltip; projected bars and target tracks hatched
in Border/Neutral/Subtle. Vertical: the Line chart's frame (dashed grid, 6 Y labels, X pills, ←/→); the bars run edge
to edge Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart, as wide as the count allows, rounded on the top corners over a flat base. Horizontal: a
category column, 24px bars Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart (flat at the axis, thicker in a taller card), a value column at the end of the rows (the active one in Strongest; no Tooltip floats over
the bars, the user 2026-10-13) and a value axis below (↑/↓). Home/End jump to the first and last bar. Figma Chart/Bar-Chart
15321:84071 (Orientation=Vertical 15321:80574 · Horizontal 15321:82941; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`); the hatch is
.Chart/Hatch 15321:475.

props.description:

components.name: DonutChart
components.description:
Donut chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): slices in palette order,
parted by 2px gaps (Spacing/Gap/3XSmall) of the same width from the hole to the rim, each slice's corners rounded 4px, a Surface/Default %
pill (Label/Small/Medium) on each slice of 6% or more, and the total in the centre (Heading/4, Caption/Regular caption)
— or, with `totalPosition="start"`, beside the ring above the legend (Body/Small/Regular caption, Display/4 figure, as
the Chart Card's description and value). Hover or ←/→ pick a slice: the centre shows it and the others dim; Home/End jump
to the first and last slice, and leaving the chart shows the total again. Figma Chart/Donut-Chart 15324:80365
(Legend=Bottom · Start; Size=Small 120 · Medium 168 · Large 240 · XLarge 320; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`).

props.name: data
props.description: The shares of one total (`{ id, label, value }`), drawn clockwise from 12 o'clock in palette order. Keep 2–7 slices.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the centre figure and the summary read: a function, or a preset a Zen Studio page can write as text:
 `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Diameter (Figma Size): `small` 120 · `medium` 168 (default) · `large` 240 · `xlarge` 320 px, in either spelling
 (`sm` … `xl`); a number still sets px. The ring is 22% of it; it never grows past its box, and a stretched Chart Card
 grows it. Small shows the centre figure alone (Body/Base/Bold), XLarge in Display/4.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows ("Spending by category, September 2026").

props.name: value
props.description: The total figure. Default: the total, formatted. The active slice's value replaces it while one is picked.

props.name: label
props.description: The caption of the total ("Invoiced in Q3"). Default: the locale's “Total”.

props.name: totalPosition
props.description:
Where the total sits: in the hole (`centre`, default), or above the legend in a start column beside the ring
 (`start`: the hole stays empty, the legend lists down that column; Figma Total=Start).

props.name: showPercent
props.description: A % pill on every slice of 6% or more (default true).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend names every slice (default true; colour is never the only key).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description:
Legend below (default), above, or beside the ring (start / end). With `totalPosition="start"` it is always in the
 start column, under the total.

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow every slice from its start angle on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) colours the slices in palette order; `secondary` swaps the first two (the first
 slice Color Chart Sector/Secondary, the second Sector/Primary). A slice's own `color` still wins.

components.name: RadialChart
components.description:
Radial chart (ring gauges) in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): concentric
10px rings in palette order with round ends, each over a dotted Border/Neutral/Subtle track, and a centre figure
(Heading/4, Caption/Regular caption). Hover or ←/→ pick a ring: the centre shows it and the others dim; Home/End jump
to the outer and inner ring. Figma Chart/Radial-Chart 15325:1135 (Legend=Bottom · End; Size=Small 120 · Medium 168 ·
Large 240 · XLarge 320; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`).

props.name: data

 `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41% (the value as it is). Default: the share
 of `max` in whole percent ("43%").

props.name: currency

components.name: HeatmapChart
components.description:
Heatmap in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): a 24px-tall cell per row ×
column (Corner-Radius/Small, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall apart) on 5 Support/Brand steps, column labels on top and row labels
in a 40px start column (Label/Small/Medium, Neutral/Light; a longer label widens it), a Less → More scale (Caption/Regular). Hover or the arrow keys pick a
cell (its row and column labels light up and its Tooltip reads "Tue 1 pm · 55 h"); Home/End jump to the row's first and
last cell. Figma Chart/Heatmap-Chart 15326:1043.

 text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

components.name: BarList
components.description:
Bar list: a ranking of 3–8 items, each a 32px row whose bar is as long as its share of the leader (Color Chart
Sector/Primary at 24%, the active row 48%, Corner-Radius/Small), the name inside the bar (Body/Small/Medium,
Content/Neutral/Strongest, Spacing/Padding/Small in) and the value at the end (Body/Small/Medium, Strongest, a column
Spacing/Gap/Small after the bars); rows Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart, optional column labels above (Caption/Medium,
Content/Neutral/Light). ↑/↓ and Home/End move the active row, hover picks one; the summary reads its name and value.
Figma Chart/Bar-List 15487:2473 (the chart body; the header is ChartCard's).

props.name: data
props.description:
One row per item (`{ label, value }`), already ranked by you, largest first: the list never reorders, and the
 largest value is the full length every other bar is measured against. Keep 3–8 rows (fold the rest into "Other").

props.name: headers
props.description:
Column labels above the rows: what the items are (start) and what the values measure (end), e.g.
 `{ label: "Client", value: "Revenue" }`. Caption/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light.

 preset a Zen Studio page can write as text — `"compact"` 96.4K (the default), `"currency"` $96.4K (in `currency`),
 `"percent"` 41%.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.description: What the list ranks and over which range ("Revenue by client, 2026 so far").

components.name: BulletChart
components.description:
Bullet chart: 1–4 goals, each a row with its label (Body/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest) and "actual of
target" (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base) above a 16px Corner-Radius/Rounded track (Border/Neutral/Subtle/
Pressed at 50%: Figma's Color Chart Sector/On-Color/Tertiary), the actual as an 8px Color Chart Sector/Primary bar inset
4px, and the target as a 3px Color Chart Sector/Secondary tick 24px tall; rows Spacing/Gap/Medium apart, label and
track Spacing/Gap/XSmall. A legend (Spacing/Gap/Small between items) names the bar and the tick. ↑/↓ and Home/End
pick a row (the others' marks dim), hover too; the summary reads "Revenue: $798K of $900K (1 of 3)".
Figma Chart/Bullet-Chart 15968:130554 (Color=Primary 15487:2516 · Secondary ↔ `palette`; the chart body and Show Legend; the
header is ChartCard's).

props.name: data
props.description:
One row per goal (`{ label, value, target, max }`); each row has its own scale, so goals in different units can
 share the chart. Keep 1–4 rows.

props.name: actualLabel
props.description: The legend's name for the bar. Default the label "Actual".

props.name: targetLabel
props.description: The legend's name for the tick. Default the label "Target".

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the legend that names the bar and the tick (Figma Show Legend, default true).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend below the rows (default) or above them.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the value and the target of a row ("$798K of $900K") and the summary read. A function gets the row too, so
 each goal can take its own unit: `(v, row) => (row.label === "Utilisation" ? v + "%" : String(v))`; or a
 preset a Zen Studio page can write as text: `"compact"` 1.2K (the default), `"currency"` $1.2K (in
 `currency`), `"percent"` 41%.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the goals are and for which period ("Quarter goals, Q3 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart (not the legend).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: A row active at first (the others' marks dim). Default none: every row reads alike until one is picked.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Grow the bars from the start and fade the ticks in on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced
 motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) draws the bars in Color Chart Sector/Primary and the target ticks in Sector/Secondary;

components.name: GaugeChart
components.description:
Gauge in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): one measure against a maximum as a
half ring a tenth of its width thick (Figma innerRadius 0.8) — the track Background/Neutral/Subtle, the value
Chart/Sector/Primary (Color Chart Sector/Primary) with flat ends, the target a 3px round-capped Chart/Sector/Secondary
tick 4px past both edges. The reading sits in the hole: the figure Heading/2 · Content/Neutral/Strongest over a
Body/Small/Regular · Content/Neutral/Base caption; the scale's ends (Label/Small/Medium · Content/Neutral/Light) sit
centred under the ring's two ends. The legend (Figma Show Legend) names the value and the target, Spacing/Gap/Small
apart. It is a `meter` (aria-valuenow, min 0, max `max`, value text "Billable 82%, Target 85%"): nothing in it can be
picked, so it takes no tab stop. Figma Chart/Gauge-Chart 15968:130382 (Color=Primary 15486:2467 · Secondary ↔ `palette`).

props.name: value
props.description: The reading, measured from 0 to `max` ("1,052 h", "82"). A value past `max` fills the ring and still reads as it is.

props.name: max
props.description: The value a full half ring stands for (default 100: the value is a percentage).

props.name: target
props.description: A goal on the same scale, drawn as a Chart/Sector/Secondary tick across the ring and read under the figure.

props.name: actualLabel
props.description: The legend's name for the value ("Billable"), as BulletChart's `actualLabel`. Default "Actual".

props.name: targetLabel
props.description: The legend's name for the target and the start of the default caption. Default "Target".

props.name: caption
props.description: The line under the figure. Default: the target ("Target 85%"), or `actualLabel` when there is no target.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the half ring in px (default 240, as Figma); the ring is a tenth of it thick. The gauge never grows past its box.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the figure, the target and the end labels read: a function, or a preset a Zen Studio page can write as
 text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41% (the value as it is). Default: the
 share of `max` in whole percent ("82%", "0%", "100%").

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend names the value and the target (Figma Show Legend). Default: on when there is a target.

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend below (default), above, or beside the gauge (start / end).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the gauge measures, and when ("Billable share of logged hours, September 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart (not the legend).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.description: Sweep the value from 0 on mount and when it changes; the target tick fades in after (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) draws the value in Color Chart Sector/Primary and the target tick in Sector/Secondary;
 `secondary` the value in Sector/Secondary and the tick in Sector/Primary.

components.name: FunnelChart

(Body/Small/Medium · Content/Neutral/Strongest) over its count (Caption/Regular · Content/Neutral/Light) in an 84px start
column, a 32px bar centred in its track as wide as its share of the first stage (Chart/Sector/Primary, the last stage
Chart/Sector/Secondary, Corner-Radius/Small), and the share at the end (Body/Small/Medium, right-aligned). Rows
Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart, columns Spacing/Gap/Small. Stages are pickable like horizontal bars: hover or ↑/↓ and
Home/End pick one (the others dim) and the summary reads its name, count and share. Figma Chart/Funnel-Chart 15968:130460
(Color=Primary 15486:2497 · Secondary ↔ `palette`).

props.description:
One stage per step, first contact first (`{ label, value }`): each bar is as wide as its share of the first stage.
 Keep 3–6 stages.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the counts under the stage names and in the summary read (the shares are whole percent of the first
 stage): a function, or a preset a Zen Studio page can write as text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in
 `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the funnel shows and over which range ("Leads to signed projects, Q3 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart (not the legend).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description:
The stage picked at first (the others dim). Default none: every stage at full strength until one is hovered or reached
 with ↑/↓.

props.name: animate
props.description: Open every bar from its centre on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) draws the stages in Color Chart Sector/Primary and the last in Sector/Secondary;
 `secondary` the stages in Sector/Secondary and the last in Sector/Primary.

components.name: AreaChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Area-Chart (set 15484:2663; Type=Area 15484:2552 · Type=Stacked 15484:2605; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`): straight 2px lines (round caps)
in the Color Chart Sector styles (`chartPalette`) from the first period's centre to the last, each over an area that
fades top → bottom from Solid to Subtle at 30% (Figma 2026-10-14: Background/Accent, then Neutral, then Support/Cyan,
as the line chart's area; `chartFades`) — one area, or stacked bands — on the bar charts' frame: Y labels (Label/Small/Medium,
Content/Neutral/Light) right-aligned in a column Spacing/Padding/XSmall before the plot, dashed 4 / 4
Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines, a solid Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle baseline, X labels under it (the active one a pill).
The active period shows a 12px dot on each line (Surface/Default, 2px ring in the series colour), a 1px
Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle rule from the top dot to the baseline and the Tooltip beside the dot, a dot's width away:
the value, or the stack's total. The legend (Figma Show Legend) sits Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot, its items
Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End move between periods; hover picks one.

props.name: data
props.description: One period per item, a value per series id (`{ label: "Sep", values: { design: 750, … } }`). Keep 4–12 periods.

props.name: series
props.description:
The measured series, bottom first: one for `type="area"` (only the first is drawn), 2–4 for `"stacked"`
 (harness: chart/area-series-count). Lines walk the Figma styles Color Chart Sector/Primary …, areas fade from the
 slot's Solid to its Subtle (Accent, Neutral, Support Cyan …; `chartFades`), unless a series sets `color`.

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Type: `area` (default) — one measure as a line over its fading area; `stacked` — 2–4 series as fading bands
 stacked bottom-up with a line on top of each band, so the top line reads the period's total.

props.name: format
props.description:
How axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary read (`2,210 h`, `$23.4K`): a function, or a preset a Zen Studio
 page can write as text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in px, lanes included (6px above the grid for the top Y label, 28px below it for the X labels).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Billable hours per month, Apr – Sep 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart frame (the axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description:
The period active at first and whenever the pointer leaves. Default: none — the active period and its Tooltip show
 only under the pointer or the keyboard (the user, 2026-10-26).

props.name: showLegend
props.description:
Figma Show Legend: the legend names every series. Default: on for `stacked`, off for a single `area` (the card title
 names its one measure). Keep it on a stacked chart (harness: chart/series-need-legend).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description: Wipe the areas in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) walks the palette in order; `secondary` swaps the first two series' lines and fades —
 a single area draws a Color Chart Sector/Secondary line over the Neutral fade, a stacked chart's bottom band takes the
 Neutral pair and the next the Accent pair. A series' own `color` still wins.

components.name: GroupedBarChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Grouped-Bar-Chart (15485:2457; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`): per period a group of 12px bars, one per series, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall
apart, centred in the period's column (with room to spare the group grows to 70% of the column, bars up to 32px); each bar takes its series' Color Chart Sector style (`chartPalette`) with
Corner-Radius/XSmall on its top corners. The bar charts' frame: Y labels (Label/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light)
right-aligned Spacing/Padding/XSmall before the plot, dashed 4 / 4 Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines over a solid
Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle baseline, X labels under it (the active one a pill). The active group keeps its colours
(the others ease to 88%, as stacked columns), its Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle rule and the Tooltip in the top lane,
which reads every series' value after its dot. The legend (Figma Show Legend) sits Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot,
its items Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End move between groups; hover picks one.

props.name: data
props.description:
One group per period or category, a value per series id (`{ label: "Sep", values: { invoiced: 105700, collected: 88300 } }`).
 Keep 3–12 groups.

props.name: series
props.description:
The compared series, 2–3, side by side in each group in this order (harness: chart/grouped-series-count). Colours
 walk the Figma styles Color Chart Sector/Primary · Secondary · Tertiary unless a series sets `color`.

props.name: format
props.description:
How axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary read: a function, or a preset a Zen Studio page can write as
 text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"`.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in px, lanes included (36px above the grid for the Tooltip, 28px below it for the X labels).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Invoiced and collected per month, Apr – Sep 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart frame (the axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description:
The group active at first and whenever the pointer leaves. Default: none — the active group and its Tooltip show
 only under the pointer or the keyboard (the user, 2026-10-26).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Figma Show Legend: the legend names every series; keep it (harness: chart/series-need-legend). Default on.

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the bars from the baseline on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) walks the palette in order; `secondary` swaps the first two series (the first
 Color Chart Sector/Secondary, the second Sector/Primary). A series' own `color` still wins.

components.name: ComboChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Combo-Chart (15485:2519; Color=Primary · Secondary ↔ `palette`): two measures over the same periods on two axes. Bars (Color Chart Sector/Primary,
filling the periods edge to edge Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart; Corner-Radius/XSmall on the top corners over a flat base) read the start axis; a straight 2px Color Chart Sector/Secondary line
(round caps) with an 8px dot on every period (Surface/Default, 2px ring) reads the end axis. Both axes take
Label/Small/Medium in Content/Neutral/Light, Spacing/Padding/XSmall from the plot (the start one right-aligned, the end
one left-aligned) and share the dashed 4 / 4 Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines over a solid Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle
baseline. The active period keeps its bar (the others ease to 88%), its dot grows to 12px, and the Tooltip in the top
lane reads both values after their dots; X labels under the plot (the active one a pill). The legend (Figma Show
Legend) names both measures Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot, its items Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End
move between periods; hover picks one.

props.name: data
props.description: One period per item (`{ label: "Sep", bar: 105700, line: 41 }`). Keep 4–12 periods.

props.name: barLabel
props.description: What the bars measure ("Revenue"), named in the legend, the Tooltip order and the summary (harness: chart/combo-needs-labels).

props.name: lineLabel
props.description: What the line measures ("Margin"), named in the legend and the summary.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the bars' values and the start axis read (`$105.7K`): a function, or a preset a Zen Studio page can write
 as text: `"compact"` 1.2K, `"currency"` $1.2K (in `currency`), `"percent"` 41%. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: currency
props.description:
The currency of `format="currency"`: an ISO 4217 code ("USD", the default; "EUR", "VND"). Set alone it implies
 `format="currency"` for the bars; `lineFormat="currency"` takes it too.

props.name: lineFormat
props.description: How the line's values and the end axis read (`41%`): a function or a preset, as `format`. Default: 1.2K.

props.name: lineMax
props.description:
The top of the end axis (100 for a share in %). Default: a round top over the line's values, on the same gridlines
 as the start axis.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in px, lanes included (36px above the grid for the Tooltip, 28px below it for the X labels).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue and margin per month, Apr – Sep 2026").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the chart frame (both axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend).

props.name: initialIndex
props.description:
The period active at first and whenever the pointer leaves. Default: none — the active period and its Tooltip show
 only under the pointer or the keyboard (the user, 2026-10-26).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Figma Show Legend: the legend names the bars and the line; keep it (harness: chart/series-need-legend). Default on.

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description:
Grow the bars from the baseline and wipe the line in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default
 true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: palette
props.description:
Figma Color: `primary` (default) draws Color Chart Sector/Primary bars and a Sector/Secondary line; `secondary`
 draws Sector/Secondary bars and a Sector/Primary line and dots.

components.name: ChartCard
components.description:
Figma Chart/Chart-Card (6643:63528): Card Flat Medium (padding 24, radius 24) → header · Segmented · chart, gap 16.
The header row holds the title, the Hint (an info icon whose Tooltip carries the chart's description) and the open
chevron; the metric label and the headline value follow it (every Figma chart card's Title · Show Hint · Show Open ·
Show Metric Label · Metric Label · Show Value · Value · Show Ranges properties; Show Icon · Icon stay, off by default).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Header Label (Body/Extra/Medium, 2026-10-21).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title: one level below the nearest heading above (default 3: a card inside an h2 section; 2
 when the card sits directly under the page h1). The look stays Body/Extra/Medium — the level follows the outline,
 not the size. An EmptyState in `children` takes the next level in Body/Extra/Bold, below the card title.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon before the title (20px, Content/Neutral/Strongest): an icon name or a node. Decorative; the title names the card.
 Figma Show Icon is off by default: chart headers carry no icon (the user, 2026-10-26), so leave it out.

props.name: hint
props.description:
Figma Hint (Show Hint): an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) at the end of the header that shows this text in a
 Tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Put the chart's description here (what it counts, its source, how the figure is
 worked out) so the card itself stays the title, the metric and the chart; leave it out when the title says enough.

props.name: metricLabel
props.description:
Figma Metric Label: what the headline figure is ("Invoiced so far in 2026"), Body/Small/Regular over the value, under
 the Segmented (Chart/Line-Chart: Padding/Small above, Gap/3XSmall to the value).

props.name: description
props.deprecated: Renamed `metricLabel` (Figma Metric Label, 2026-10-26). A description of the chart goes in `hint`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The headline figure the chart explains ("$4,346.00"), Display/4 (Figma Chart-Card Metric > Value), under the
 metric label and the Segmented.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Figma Header trailing Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary (chevron): opens the full report.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open button. Default: the locale's “Open report”.

props.name: ranges
props.description: Figma Segmented (Secondary) range switch.

props.name: rangesFullWidth
props.description:
The range switch fills the card and splits it into equal items (Figma Segmented FILL, default); `false` hugs its
 items, as on a wide card where a full-width switch would stretch far past its labels (Figma HUG).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Figma nested Card Theme: Default (default, the Surface alone) inside a panel or section; Shadow when the chart card
 sits on the canvas next to other Shadow cards (metric cards on a dashboard); the other themes follow the Card rules
 for the page's Canvas (harness theme/box-on-canvas).

props.name: color
props.description: Figma nested Card Color, for theme="pale", "subtle" or "solid": the Card's hue (Solid Neutral is the dark widget; see Card).

props.name: surface
props.description: Figma nested Card Surface: default · alt (Default, Border); see Card. A chart on a Canvas/Flat page takes theme="flat-border".

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Figma nested Card Spacing: Medium (default; Card-padding-medium, Corner-Radius/2XLarge) · Small (Card-padding-small,
 Corner-Radius/Large) · XSmall (Card-padding-xsmall, Corner-Radius/Base), for a chart in a narrow tile or a row of
 several on a phone. Short (md, sm, xs) or Figma (medium, small, xsmall) spelling.

props.name: children
props.description: The chart, or an EmptyState before there is data (keep the card title; the Empty State is set one level below it).

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the Card's root `<div>`.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the open button and range control it draws, by layer (`{ Open: { level: "secondary" }, "Ranges/Item[week]": { level: "primary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets onOpen / ranges.
